- `SFSE-MCP/`: the SFSE Menu Framework SDK by QTR-Modding (Quantumyilmaz), MIT,
  https://github.com/QTR-Modding/SFSE-MCP at ea48af1 (SDK 1.2.0, matching SFSE Menu
  Framework 1.2.0). Headers only; see its LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.
- `CLibUtilsQTR/`: the signing module headers of CLibUtilsQTR by Quantumyilmaz, SkyrimThiago
